about: What playback does when a song fails. Shared golden cases: Android RecoveryPolicy (PlaybackErrorRecovery.kt) and desktop src/recovery.rs must both agree. attempts counts failures of this song so far (1 = first failure). decision: retry (with delayMs), skip, or stay.

cases.name: first network failure retries after 350 ms
third failure skips a song that never started
a permanent error skips at once
a song that played before stays after giving up
after 4 skips in a row it stops skipping
3 skips in a row still skips
a permanent error skips even after many in a row
